svg.title: GrimGlow Issue 6 — Page 15 — "A Tradition" — Section 3 protocol comparison + ascent
svg.desc: Page 15: 4 panels in 3 tiers (half-half / full / full). Wide juxtaposition of claw-marks (amber-black, LEFT) and fairy glyph (blue-white, RIGHT) with Luma airborne sweeping between — two civilizations, same age. Comparison HUD shows this basement glyph predates the I4 alley glyph by centuries but follows identical simplification methodology — a centuries-long protocol. Multiple operatives. Luma descends, scanner clutched, "How long were you here?" Ascent through iron grate to Theodore's reaching hands.
